Automatisation.Definition: Use of technologies to perform tasks without human intervention

Computer Automation.Definition: Use of a system of instructions to automate repetitive processes on computer systems

Business Automation.Definition: Aligning business process and business rules management with the development of modern applications

DevOps.Definition: The combination of cultural philosophies, practices, and tools that increase an organization’s ability to deliver applications and services at high velocity

Integration.Role: Automation of the process of compilation, tests, and deployment

Code Control and Collaboration.Role: Management of the source code and tracking of changes

Testing.Role: Automation of unit, functional, performance, and security tests
